Name: Frog Companion (FS)
Author: Gabett
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

Would you like to be accompanied by a little frog companion during your adventures? Would you like to have them around even while you have a different trinket equipped? Well, look no further!

This mod adds a little frog as a Fashion Sense accessory that can accompany you around the valley. There are two variations, one freely tintable and one prismatic. Based on the in-game frog trinket, expanded with additional sprites.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url].
3. Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley / Mods [/font]OR import to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]﻿.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b][size=4]Permissions[/size][/b]

Don't use it in stuff that's being sold, but otherwise feel free to do with it as you please. It does use vanilla assets, so keep that in mind in the unlikely case that you want to use it in a non-Stardew mod.
